main_text.p: mum sedi Byzantina restitueret, eosque qui for-midolose, aut subdole Spiritum, ex Filio proce-dere dicere audebant, ab Ecclesia pelleret, & profligaret, quod & optime persoluit. Huic itaque Synodo, & sanctissimus Papa Ioannes, qui tum Romana Ecclesia praerat, per Petrum Presbyterum & Cardinalem, Paulum, & Eugenium Episcopos, & Locumtenentes suum assensum praebuit, eumque, qui in posterum aut addere, aut demere ausus esset, anathemati subiecit; pro illo subscribentibus proprie & Romano charactere locumtenentibus, vel potius illo eodem per eosdem subscribente, quorum ad hunc usque diem in testimonium subscriptiones in magna Ecclesia conseruantur.
Quodsi quibus ipsi dogmatibus addicti subscripsere, & per eos sanctissimus Papa, auetis edifcere [?], sextam huiusce Synodi actionem si percurreritis, deprehendetis. &c. Nilus Damyla.

Οὐ μὲν ἀλλὰ καὶ τὸν καιρὸν Φώτιε ἐν Κωνσταντινουπόλει Σωσό-σθ[?] τῇ κυδῶσι τῆς Θεοβίης Βασιλέως Βασιλεὺς τῶν Μακεδόνων πλεόνων ἢ γιακοσίων ἀρχιερέων, ἤ πῆς ἐπηγέραπται ἡ ἀρχὴ, ἐ οἰκουμενικὴ Σωσόθεος. τῇ δ᾽ Σωσόθῳ παρηνᾶς καὶ οἱ τλὼ γνώμῳ ἅμα, καὶ ὁ ἐξ τὰ κάμεια τῆς διαγράφων φεύνημα τὴν ἐπέρων Ἐκκλησιῶν αἰσπθέ-μένου, καὶ ἀπαλγῆσουῆς. Ἡ δ᾽ αἰτία, ἀλλ᾽ ὡς σωπᾶσθαι αὐτὴν ἡ ἱερὰ Σωσόθεος ὡς τὸν τὸν Νικόλαον ἐκκηρύκτον διὰ τῆς Ἐκκλησίας ἐξ τὸ τλωικὸν[?] ἀφ-

page.notes: Greek passages are read with many doubtful letters; the Greek text is a best reading and needs checking against the scan, especially the names and the end of the Greek lines. "edifcere" and "auetis" are uncertain. The line ending "ἀφ-" is the catchword and is given under bottom_margin, not in the text. The page number 166 is printed at the head. No running head is printed. Show-through and the edge of the scan are not transcribed.
